$comment: THE single source of truth for environment identity across Enterprise Operations OS.
Originally the C3/D2 drift registry (which environments exist, where their frontends are);
extended by O-3 to also carry each environment's Firebase identity and capability readiness,
so there is ONE authoritative mechanism rather than separate ad hoc ones for D2, R-2, Firebase
configuration, readiness flags, and operator scripts.
READ-ONLY DECLARATION. Nothing here provisions, deploys, renames, or mutates infrastructure.
Adding an entry does not create an environment; it records one that exists or is planned.
MODELLING: `role` (what an environment is FOR) is independent of `deployment` (whose instance
it is). `production` is NOT synonymous with Taylor Parts â€” see docs/architecture/ADR-011.
SECRETS: `firebase` holds PUBLIC Firebase Web client configuration only. A Firebase Web apiKey
is a public project identifier, not a credential â€” access is enforced by Firestore Rules and
Auth, not by hiding it. No service-account key, token, or private credential belongs in this
file, and a test asserts that.

environments.purpose: Local developer/agent execution against the Firebase Emulator Suite. Synthetic data only; never production credentials.
environments.notes: Firebase identity is null by design: the emulator path is opt-in via ?emulator=1 and DEV-gated, and must never carry a real project identity.

environments.purpose: Persistent non-production platform environment: synthetic data, governed test personas, full integrated application.

surfaces.notes: Stable Owner review URL. Rebuilt freely; no delete protection, PITR or backups by design.

environments.notes: Provisioned 2026-08-06 (O-1..O-8). Complete platform estate: 35 Functions (13 more than production, which has never deployed the Enterprise Access + Supplier Master callables), full Rules, all 6 indexes.

environments.purpose: Exact integrated Release Candidate on a stable Owner-review URL with a known SHA.
environments.notes: NOT PROVISIONED. Initially expected to share infrastructure with platform-sandbox as a distinct logical role; the forcing condition for a physical split is concurrency (an RC under review while sandbox rebuilds).

environments.purpose: First customer production deployment of Enterprise Operations OS.

surfaces.notes: Owner-authorized, evidenced releases. SPA catch-all rewrite returns 200 + text/html for any unmatched path, so manifest ABSENCE cannot be detected by status code â€” the checker validates content, never status alone.
Auto-publishes on merge to main, outside the promotion lifecycle. Recorded as an open governance gap (R-2); this registry observes it and does not change it.
